general_rule: Judge only whether title+slug unambiguously instantiate the frozen family mechanism. Accept requires a discrete event matching the family definition; reject wrong-domain/topic/generic mention/content-question/structural mismatch; use ambiguous whenever title+slug alone is insufficient. Never infer missing context to increase sample size.

family_rubric.EARNINGS_EPS: Accept only a named issuer's earnings/EPS release or discrete earnings/EPS result. Reject earnings-call speech/topic questions, generic financial discussion, stock-price-only questions, and other corporate events.
family_rubric.FDA_ADVISORY_COMMITTEE: Accept only a specific FDA advisory committee/advisory panel meeting, recommendation or vote. Reject generic/final FDA approval decisions.
family_rubric.FDA_FINAL_PDUFA_DECISION: Accept only a specific final FDA action such as approval/authorization/PDUFA/CRL. Reject advisory-only outcomes and non-FDA regulatory decisions.
family_rubric.MA_PRE_ANNOUNCEMENT_OR_RUMOR: Accept only whether a specific merger/acquisition/takeover/bid will be announced/emerge before a definitive public transaction. Reject already-announced closing/clearance questions.
family_rubric.MA_PENDING_COMPLETION: Accept only an already-announced specific transaction whose binary uncertainty is closing/completion or a non-regulatory closing condition. Reject generic deal/news questions and regulatory-clearance-specific questions.
family_rubric.MA_REGULATORY_CLEARANCE: Accept only a specific announced M&A transaction whose question is merger-control/regulatory approval, challenge or blocking.
family_rubric.ANTITRUST_ENFORCEMENT_SINGLE_NAME: Accept only explicit non-merger antitrust/competition enforcement concerning a named company/conduct matter. Generic DOJ/FTC investigations without explicit antitrust semantics are rejected.
family_rubric.FOMC_DECISION: Accept only a specific scheduled FOMC monetary-policy decision/meeting outcome. Reject speeches, emergency unscheduled actions, annual counts, derivatives, and non-FOMC macro releases.
family_rubric.MACRO_STATISTICAL_RELEASE: Accept only a specific scheduled official CPI/PPI/payroll/employment/GDP/retail-sales statistical release observation. Reject sports, markets merely mentioning currencies, forecasts not tied to an official release, and FOMC decisions.
family_rubric.CORPORATE_LITIGATION_BINARY: Accept only a discrete corporate litigation/court/bankruptcy outcome affecting a named company. Reject sports 'vs/court', criminal/political cases, antitrust/M&A and generic legal news.

adjudication_method.independent_context: Each row is judged from allowed fields only; no web lookup is permitted during semantic adjudication.
adjudication_method.uncertainty_policy: When factual context not in title+slug is required, choose AMBIGUOUS_UNRESOLVED rather than guessing.

coverage.earnings_top_up: If fewer than 80 EARNINGS_EPS rows are ACCEPT_STRICT_FAMILY after the initial 100 and additional provisional Earnings clusters exist, reveal the next clusters strictly by frozen adjudication_rank and adjudicate until 80 accepts or exhaustion.
coverage.other_families: The initial queue already contains all provisional clusters for every non-Earnings family; there is no top-up outside Earnings.

downstream.PIT_input: Only ACCEPT_STRICT_FAMILY rows, after adjudication materialization and a new PIT protocol freeze.

prohibitions: No semantic-v1 results may be reused.
No review-field expansion after reading the queue.
No family redefinition or threshold relaxation after accepted counts are visible.
No F1-F9, IAS, ranking, realized-return or W3 decision during adjudication.
